lines.text: Twinkle twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are!
Did you know real stars are NOT pointy shapes at all?
Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky!
Each star is actually a giant glowing ball of super hot gas, just like our sun!
They look like tiny dots only because they are trillions of miles away!
When starlight passes through our wobbly air, it twinkles like magic!
So next time you look up, you know you are seeing giant cosmic suns!
Now you know the real truth behind Twinkle Twinkle Little Star!
Sing along and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for more fun discoveries!
